subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should `ChannelPlugin.reload.accountScopedRestart` become a supported reusable plugin capability, with Mattermost as the first opt-in implementation?
rationale: The patch is technically scoped and documented, but choosing whether this reusable plugin API is part of OpenClaw's supported contract cannot be safely inferred from tests or a single channel implementation.

options.title: Adopt the capability contract
options.body: Accept the documented opt-in contract and merge Mattermost as the first channel that proves isolated account resolution, lifecycle ownership, and durable-ingress recovery.

options.title: Keep account reloads core-private
options.body: Do not expose the opt-in on `ChannelPlugin`; retain whole-channel restart behavior until maintainers choose a narrower internal seam or a broader channel strategy.

options.title: Defer the API decision
options.body: Pause this PR until gateway and plugin owners define the supported extension boundary and upgrade expectations for future channel opt-ins.

recommendation.title: Adopt the capability contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented opt-in contract and merge Mattermost as the first channel that proves isolated account resolution, lifecycle ownership, and durable-ingress recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and latest durable-ingress alignment commit make steipete the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
